transcript_segments.text: My bank had passed if I wanted financial insights bold I said mate I've got insights
what I need is money I'm asset rich in cash port which means I can
explain the entire machine while standing in the kitchen calculating the
cheese I got skills like emergency candles bright useful mostly used when
something is failed I know how to fix three broken systems four sad people
and one route a by thread and then it gently I can write the email that makes
the room behave I can read the silence in a meeting in here who is about to
quit I can turn a wound into a chorus a panic attack into a plan a cheap
pitarin to a small republic for the over drawn still the boiler blinks like a
moral question the rent arise with this little crown on the fridge contains
mustard light and the idea of dinner I count what I know when the numbers don't
line golden my head and dust in my hand I'm asset rich cash port still holding
door got a fortune in nerve and a bill on the floor made the class roof with the
weather coming through our own what I learned the bank on the view if wisdom
paid rent I'd be hard to ignore but I'm asset rich cash port diversified portfolio
one useful brain three mugs and a cardigan with leadership potential they told
us knowledge was a lab a climate earn it be clever so I climb till my hands
went numb a nice little view of everyone below me also climate also rent
and also one bad month from the common a cautionary linked in post I did the
courses read the books learn the language of rooms or glass wall stay cold
a pipeline resilience tiny spell words for people who were tired but
laminated and yes uncomfortable comparatively I've got heeding most days
a dentist I avoid for emotional reasons and coffee that cost enough to have
opinions so I won't pretend I'm at the bottom I'm just close enough to hear
it breathing close enough to know the floor is not a floor it's a subscription
asset rich cash port still holding the door got a fortune in nerve and a bill on the floor
made the class roof with the weather coming through our own what I learned but
the bank owns the view if wisdom paid rent I'd be hard to ignore but I'm asset rich cash port
and the cruel joke is I do feel rich not always not when the car makes a sound
like a bag of color it being judged not when the invoice sits in my inbox with
its shoes on but sometimes when a friend says how did you know what I meant
when a line arrives clean and true after weeks of scraping fork when I fix
something with patients instead of panic when the small room fills with people
who trust me enough to be tired then I feel rich disgustingly rich I'll sure
account in the sole private island if not giving up and know that does not pay
the council tax I have checked repeatedly but it means the ledger is incomplete
it means the market is terrible eyesight it means some forms of wealth refuse to behave like wealth
maybe that's the trick at the end of the album not pretending broke his holy not calling pressure character
because someone rich needs the story tidy but refusing to let the till name every treasurer
I have been porting cash and obscene questions then and savings every with songs one foot in the middle class
one foot over the drop door both hands full of things I couldn't sell without becoming less alive
so let the spreadsheet shake its head let be up offer insights let the landlord call it passive income
like my boss isn't active expense I am still here still learning still useful still making soup
from weather and why are my set rich cash pours still hold in the door got a fortune in nerve and a bill on the floor
made the class roof with the weather coming through our own what I learned but the bank owns the view with wisdom paid rent
I'd be hard to ignore but I'm our set rich cash pour I'm dead to wear hope source still singing for more
I'm a hard in the red and a light in the store if love had a wage we don't make it through so I count what is left and I share it with you
my bank app says I'm spending too much on groceries fair but tonight there are four people at my table laughing like the rent can't hear us and for once
the numbers can't wait outside
